subject: Dragon's Scale
text: The Dragon's Scale raises defense power by 2 points, but it must be donned by selecting it from the items menu rather than equipping automatically like armor.

evidence.quote: It raises your defense power 2 points which is nearly doubled if you buy it in level 1. It is not automatic like armor, though. You must don it by selecting it from the items menu.

subject: Erdrick's Token
text: Erdrick's Token is hidden in the middle of the right side of the large swamp at coordinates 70' South 40' West.

evidence.quote: It is located at 70' South 40' West and the game instructions say you need Gwelin's Love but you don't. It is pretty easy it pinpoint the location without knowing your distance. It is in the middle of the right side of the large swamp

subject: Erdrick's Token
text: Erdrick's Token must be shown to the man in the southern cave to prove you are Erdrick's descendant in order to obtain the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote: The item you need to show the man in the southern cave that you are really Erdrick's descendant. Without this, you cannot get the rainbow drop.

subject: Fairy Water
text: Fairy Water functions the same as the Repel spell learned at level 15 to ward off weak enemies, but it requires keys and gold to purchase.

evidence.quote: The repel spell helps but since you don't get that until level 15, Fairy Water helps a lot. It does everything Repel does, but you need keys to get it and you need to pay for it too.

subject: Fairy Flute
text: The Fairy Flute is hidden in the town of Kol, exactly 5 steps downward from the spot directly beneath the rheumatism cure bath.

evidence.quote: It can be found in the town of Kol. You will see a square of water which is supposed to be a bath that cures Rheumatism. Walk to the spot directly beneath this fountain and take exactly 5 steps
downward and search. You will find the fairy flute there.

subject: Fairy Flute
text: The Fairy Flute is needed to put Golem, who guards Cantlin, to sleep.

evidence.quote: Needed to put Golem to sleep. He is the guy that looks like a Orange left handed Goldman, guarding Cantlin.

subject: Fighter's Ring
text: The Fighter's Ring is found in the Mountain Cave, does not increase Attack or Magic Power, and sells for 15 gold.

evidence.quote: Found in the Mountain Cave. It doesn't do anything. It increases neither your Attack or Magic Power. The only thing it is good for is selling and it only sells for 15 gold.

subject: Gwaelin's Love
text: Gwaelin's Love is a device given after rescuing Gwaelin that tells how much experience is needed to reach the next level.

evidence.quote: After you rescue Gwaelin, she gives you a present. It is some kind of device, that lets her talk to you when you are out fighting enemies and in caves (like a cell phone.) It is very useful because it tells you how much experience you need to get to the next level

subject: Herbs
text: Herbs cost 24 gold each, can be held in quantities up to 6 at once, and restore health like the Heal spell.

evidence.quote: Do the same as heal spell only more efficiently. They cost 24 gold and you can carry up to 6 at once.

subject: Magic Key
text: Magic Keys cost 53 gold in Rimuldar, 85 gold in Tantagel Castle, and 93 gold in Cantlin.

evidence.quote: There are three places to buy them. Rimildar for 53 gold, Tantagel Castle for 85 gold, and Cantlin for 93.

subject: Rainbow Drop
text: Bringing Erdrick's Token, the Staff of Rain, and the Stones of Sunlight to the old man in the cave south of Rimildar creates the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote: When you get Erdrick's Token, Staff of the Rain, and Stones of the Sunlight, bring them to the old man in the cave south of Rimildar. He will make them into the rainbow drop.

subject: Rainbow Drop
text: Using the Rainbow Drop from the items menu at the channel on the sand northwest of Rimildar creates the bridge to Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote: Needed to make the rainbow bridge to get to Charlock Castle...Then go to the channel on the sand that is just a little but northwest of Rimildar, Walk right in front of it and select Rainbow Drop from items menu and the water will flash many colors and you will hear all sorts of sounds and then a bridge will appear.

subject: Silver Harp
text: The Silver Harp is found in the Grave of Garinham and attracts enemies when played.

evidence.quote: Found in the Grave of Garninham. When you play it, it attracts enemies.

subject: Staff of Rain
text: The Staff of Rain is obtained by trading the Silver Harp to the old man in the cave located north in the woods past the narrow tree passage west of Kol.

evidence.quote: You want to go to the cave that is way up north in the woods and give it to the old man there. To get there go just a little west of Kol and you will see a very narrow passage of trees surrounded by water on the bottom and mountains on the top. Take that path and then go north and you will eventually see the stairs you need to go down.
One of the three items necessary for you to have the Rainbow Drop. You trade an old guy the silver harp for it.

subject: Stones of Sunlight
text: The Stones of Sunlight are found in a treasure chest held by an old man in the basement of Tantagel Castle, reached by unlocking a door by the northern exit, walking down the grass without leaving the castle, and descending the stairs.

evidence.quote: Found in the basement of Tantagel Castle. In the castle, go to where the northern exit is, and go right and you will see a door. Unlock it and go right until you are on grass next to the Castle, do NOT walk any further to the right or you will leave the castle and have to do it over again. When you are on this grass go straight down and eventually you will see another staircase. Take this staircase downstairs and you will see an old man with a treasure chest.
